photoobj_star_cohort.name: photoobj_star_cohort
photoobj_star_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.extinction_r
FROM photoobj_as_record p
JOIN photo_type_lookup t ON p.type = t.value
WHERE
  -- liftable literal: classify as 'STAR' by name in photo_type_lookup
  t.name = 'STAR'
  -- basic cleanliness filter: require clean flag non-zero (lifted literal)
  AND p.clean = 1
  -- ensure essential positional magnitudes are present (lifted literal: max allowed NULLs = 0)
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
photoobj_star_cohort.description: Cohort of photoobj rows that represent photometric objects classified as stars and passing a basic cleanliness filter; useful as the base set for star-focused queries.

photoobj_rows.name: photoobj_rows
photoobj_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- core identifier
  po.objid,
  -- observational identifiers
  po.run,
  po.rerun,
  po.field,
  po.mode,
  po.type,
  po.clean,
  -- positional centroid columns
  po.rowc,
  po.colc,
  -- cmodel magnitudes (lifted as literals should be placed outside view; here we expose columns)
  po.cmodelmag_u,
  po.cmodelmag_g,
  po.cmodelmag_r,
  -- celestial position
  po.ra,
  po.dec,
  -- PSF/aperture magnitudes
  po.u,
  po.g,
  po.r,
  po.i,
  po.z
FROM photoobj AS po
photoobj_rows.description: Base row-level projection of the photoobj table exposing core identifiers, positional columns, photometry, and metadata for downstream filtering and joins.

SELECT

specobj_base.name: specobj_base
specobj_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  specobj.bestobjid AS bestobjid,
  specobj.specobjid AS specobjid
FROM
  specobj
WHERE
  -- restrict to rows with a linked photometric object when present;
  -- liftable literal: include rows even if bestobjid IS NULL (remove '= true' to change)
  (specobj.bestobjid IS NOT NULL)
specobj_base.description: Canonical spectroscopic observation rows exposing linking key bestobjid and spectral primary key specobjid, with basic spectral metadata like ra/dec/z. Useful to determine which photometric objects have spectra and for joining spectral properties.

photo_with_spectrum.name: photo_with_spectrum
photo_with_spectrum.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra AS ra,
  p.dec AS dec,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(s.specobjid) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS has_spectrum,
  COUNT(s.specobjid) AS spectrum_count
FROM
  photoobj p
LEFT JOIN
  specobj s
ON
  s.bestobjid = p.objid
GROUP BY
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec
photo_with_spectrum.description: Denormalized row-level join showing photoobj rows that have at least one matching spectroscopic observation via specobj.bestobjid = photoobj.objid. One row per photoobj; includes photoobj identifiers and positional columns plus a flag/count indicating presence of spectra. Useful as a reusable cohort of objects with both photometry and spectroscopy.

photoobj_basic_pos_mag.name: photoobj_basic_pos_mag
photoobj_basic_pos_mag.body_sql:
SELECT
  objid AS object_id,
  ra,
  dec,
  u,
  g,
  r,
  i,
  z,
  -- Normalize clean to 0/1 integer: treat any non-zero as 1, null as 0
  COALESCE(NULLIF(clean,0)::integer, 0) AS clean,
  -- Expose raw flags for downstream filtering; ensure integer type
  COALESCE(flags::bigint, 0) AS flags
FROM photoobj
photoobj_basic_pos_mag.description: One row per photometric detection (photoobj) exposing its identifiers, celestial position, basic magnitudes and quality flags normalized for downstream filtering.

specobj_identity.body_sql:

photoobj_spec_matching_keys.name: photoobj_spec_matching_keys
photoobj_spec_matching_keys.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  s.specobjid AS matched_specobjid,
  CASE
    WHEN s.bestobjid = p.objid THEN 'bestobjid'
    WHEN s.specobjid = p.objid THEN 'specobjid'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS match_type
FROM photoobj p
JOIN specobj s
  ON p.objid = s.bestobjid
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  s.specobjid AS matched_specobjid,
  'specobjid' AS match_type
FROM photoobj p
JOIN specobj s
  ON p.objid = s.specobjid
photoobj_spec_matching_keys.description: Denormalized mapping rows that indicate which photoobj.objid values appear in specobj either as bestobjid or specobjid; one row per photoobj.objid x matched_specobjid occurrence.

photoobj_core_photometry.name: photoobj_core_photometry
photoobj_core_photometry.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.type,
  -- normalize clean to boolean-like integer: 1 when clean is nonzero (not null and not 0), else 0
  CASE
    WHEN p.clean IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN p.clean = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS clean,
  -- has_any_mag: 1 when any of u,g,r,i,z is non-null, else 0
  CASE
    WHEN p.u IS NOT NULL OR p.g IS NOT NULL OR p.r IS NOT NULL OR p.i IS NOT NULL OR p.z IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS has_any_mag
FROM
  -- prefer canonical per-photoobj record source; fall back to photoobj_rows if needed
  -- lift source literal OUT: choose 'photoobj_as_record' as primary source
  photoobj_as_record AS p
photoobj_core_photometry.description: Canonical per-photoobj row with core photometric columns, canonicalized clean flag and presence indicators for magnitudes. Keeps one row per photo object with raw magnitudes and cmodelmag, plus positional and type metadata.

photoobj_with_specobj_link.name: photoobj_with_specobj_link
photoobj_with_specobj_link.body_sql:

  p.objid AS objid,

  s.bestobjid AS spec_bestobjid,
  s.class AS spec_class,
  s.subclass AS spec_subclass
FROM
  photoobj p
LEFT JOIN
  specobj s
ON
  p.objid = s.bestobjid
photoobj_with_specobj_link.description: Per-photoobj row left-joined to spectroscopic identification(s). Exposes specobj.specobjid, specobj.bestobjid, specobj.class, specobj.subclass and flags that indicate a spectroscopic match. One row per photoobj; specobj columns are NULL when no spectroscopic match.

  s.mjd::integer AS mjd,

FROM specobj s
specobj_core.description: Core spectroscopic objects exposing primary identifiers and the link to the best-matching photometric object (bestobjid).

specobj_core_17.name: specobj_core_17
specobj_core_17.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid,
  s.class::varchar AS class,
  s.subclass::varchar AS subclass,
  s.z::real AS z,
  s.zwarning::integer AS zwarning,

FROM specobj AS s
specobj_core_17.description: Spectroscopic object canonical projection with key identifiers and links to the best photometric object (bestobjid). Exposes spectral identifiers and basic classification/z info for joins and filtering.

specobs_galaxy_flags.name: specobs_galaxy_flags
specobs_galaxy_flags.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  (g.specobjid IS NOT NULL) AS has_galspecline
FROM
  specobj s
LEFT JOIN
  galspecline g
ON
  s.specobjid = g.specobjid
specobs_galaxy_flags.description: Join that identifies specobj rows that have corresponding spectral-line galaxy entries (i.e., specobj.specobjid present in galspecline). Produces one row per specobjid and indicates presence in galspecline for easy filtering.

photoobj_galaxy_cohort.name: photoobj_galaxy_cohort
photoobj_galaxy_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.type
FROM photoobj AS p
LEFT JOIN photo_type AS pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
WHERE
  (
    pt.name = 'GALAXY'
    OR p.type = 3  -- lift numeric galaxy type code out of view; change literal if different
  )
  AND p.objid IS NOT NULL
photoobj_galaxy_cohort.description: Cohort of photometric objects identified as galaxies (either by numeric type code joined to photo_type.name='GALAXY' or by directly using the numeric type code). Exposes one row per photometric object with coords and identification to support spatial filtering and downstream aggregation.

photoobj_point_sources.name: photoobj_point_sources
photoobj_point_sources.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.type,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.run,
  p.field,
  p.mode
FROM photoobj AS p
WHERE
  -- keep only one row per detected object (photoobj.objid is primary key)
  p.objid IS NOT NULL
  -- require valid positional coordinates
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  -- require at least one measured magnitude (lifted as a literal-free rule)
  AND (p.u IS NOT NULL OR p.g IS NOT NULL OR p.r IS NOT NULL OR p.i IS NOT NULL OR p.z IS NOT NULL)
  -- optionally restrict to standard detection types: lift numeric literal for 'type' to be non-null
  AND p.type IS NOT NULL
photoobj_point_sources.description: All photometric detections (photoobj rows) representing individual detected objects (point-source detections) with canonical positional and basic photometric columns. This is a reusable spatial cohort of photo observations.

photo_type_lookup_21.name: photo_type_lookup_21
photo_type_lookup_21.body_sql:
SELECT
  pt.value::integer AS value,
  pt.name::varchar AS name,
  pt.description::text AS description
FROM photo_type pt
photo_type_lookup_21.description: Normalized mapping of photo type code to human-readable name/description for photoobj.type decoding (e.g. STAR, GALAXY, etc.).

photoobj_star_candidates.name: photoobj_star_candidates
photoobj_star_candidates.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra AS ra,
  p.dec AS dec,
  p.type AS type,
  pt.name AS "photo_type.name",
  p.u AS u,
  p.g AS g,
  p.r AS r,
  p.i AS i,
  p.z AS z
FROM photoobj AS p
JOIN photo_type AS pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
WHERE pt.name = 'STAR'
photoobj_star_candidates.description: Denormalized cohort of photoobj rows that have been labeled as stars by joining to photo_type. Useful as a ready-to-filter set of photometrically classified stars.

photoobj_point_sources_23.name: photoobj_point_sources_23
photoobj_point_sources_23.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  p.ra,
  p.dec
FROM photoobj_as_record p
WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
photoobj_point_sources_23.description: Cohort of photometric detections (one row per photometric object) with raw positional and classification columns useful for spatial and type filtering.

spectroscopic_objects_with_photometry.name: spectroscopic_objects_with_photometry
spectroscopic_objects_with_photometry.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid AS bestobjid,
  s.class AS spec_class,
  s.z AS spec_z,
  p.objid AS photo_objid,
  COALESCE(p.ra, s.ra) AS ra,
  COALESCE(p.dec, s.dec) AS dec,
  p.type AS photo_type_value
FROM specobj s
LEFT JOIN photoobj p
  ON s.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.objid = s.bestobjid
spectroscopic_objects_with_photometry.description: One row per spectroscopic observation joined to its primary photometric object when available; exposes spectroscopic classification, redshift, spectroscopic id, and the linked photometric object's position and photometric type.

specobj_classification.name: specobj_classification
specobj_classification.body_sql:

  s.zerr AS zerr,

FROM specobj s
specobj_classification.description: Per-specobj spectroscopic classification and redshift information. One row per specobj, exposing bestobjid link to photoobj and classification/z for joins and filtering by spectral class.

photoobj_with_spec_bestmatch.name: photoobj_with_spec_bestmatch
photoobj_with_spec_bestmatch.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid,

FROM specobj s
LEFT JOIN photoobj p
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
photoobj_with_spec_bestmatch.description: Denormalized join of photoobj and specobj using specobj.bestobjid -> photoobj.objid producing one row per specobj (the canonical spectroscopic record) enriched with the matched photoobj coordinates/magnitudes. Exposes both specobj.specobjid and photoobj.objid so queries can treat the spectroscopic record as the driving grain while filtering spatially on the photo object.

photoobj_basic_properties_rowlevel.name: photoobj_basic_properties_rowlevel

validated_on: What are the photometrically observable Galaxy whose right ascension is between 140.9 and 141.1, magnitude g is brighter than 18.0 and the difference of magitude u and magnitude g is greater than 2.2. Retrieve the objecti id, right ascension and declination of these objects.

specobj_photoobj_join.name: specobj_photoobj_join
specobj_photoobj_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid,
  s.ra        AS spec_ra,
  s.dec       AS spec_dec,
  s.z         AS z,
  s.zerr      AS zerr,
  s.class     AS class,
  s.subclass  AS subclass,
  s.plate     AS plate,
  s.fiberid   AS fiberid,
  p.objid     AS photoobjid,
  p.run       AS run,
  p.rerun     AS rerun,
  p.field     AS field,
  p.mode      AS mode,
  p.type      AS type,
  p.clean     AS clean,
  p.ra        AS photo_ra,
  p.dec       AS photo_dec,
  p.u         AS u,
  p.g         AS g,
  p.r         AS r,
  p.i         AS i,
  p.z         AS "z AS photo_z"
FROM
  specobj s
LEFT JOIN
  photoobj p
ON
  s.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.objid = s.bestobjid
specobj_photoobj_join.description: Denormalized join of spectroscopic observations to their matched photometric object via specobj.bestobjid = photoobj.objid. Produces one row per specobj (spectroscopic observation) with attached photo properties. Useful for queries that need both spectroscopic and photometric columns for the same astrophysical object.

specobj_primary_spectra.name: specobj_primary_spectra
specobj_primary_spectra.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.z,
  s.zerr,
  s.class,
  s.subclass,
  s.mjd,
  s.plate,
  s.fiberid
FROM specobj s
specobj_primary_spectra.description: Per-spectroscopic-observation record exposing spectroscopic identifiers and redshift information; one row per specobj.specobjid. Keeps linking keys (bestobjid) for joining to photometric objects.

spectroscopic_galaxy_cohort.name: spectroscopic_galaxy_cohort
spectroscopic_galaxy_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid
FROM specobj s
WHERE
  -- in galaxy line lists
  s.specobjid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM galspecline)
  OR
  -- in spline table
  s.specobjid IN (SELECT specobjid FROM spplines)
  OR
  -- links to a photometric object (bestobjid not null and exists in photoobj)
  (s.bestobjid IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM photoobj p WHERE p.objid = s.bestobjid))
spectroscopic_galaxy_cohort.description: Cohort of spectroscopically-observed galaxy specobjids that are in the galaxy line lists or spline tables, or that have a bestobjid linking to a photometric object. One row per specobj.specobjid. Useful as a reusable filter/cohort for queries that need spectroscopic galaxies.

photoobj_star_photometry.name: photoobj_star_photometry
photoobj_star_photometry.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj AS p
WHERE
  p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  -- require all five ugriz magnitudes to be non-null (lifted literals)
  AND p.u IS NOT NULL
  AND p.g IS NOT NULL
  AND p.r IS NOT NULL
  AND p.i IS NOT NULL
  AND p.z IS NOT NULL
photoobj_star_photometry.description: Row-level cohort of photometrically observed objects (photoobj) with non-null ugriz magnitudes and basic positional columns exposed. Useful as the base set for color-selection and brightness filters.

photoobj_colors.name: photoobj_colors
photoobj_colors.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.u AS u,
  p.g AS g,
  p.r AS r,
  p.i AS i,
  p.z AS z,
  -- color differences; lift any string/numeric literals out of the view (none needed here)
  (p.u - p.g) AS u_minus_g,
  (p.g - p.r) AS g_minus_r,
  (p.r - p.i) AS r_minus_i,
  (p.i - p.z) AS i_minus_z
FROM
  photoobj_as_record p
photoobj_colors.description: Projection of photoobj magnitudes plus commonly used color differences computed (u-g, g-r, r-i, i-z). Keeps one row per photometric object to support color cuts and derived-color filters.

photoobj_color_indices.name: photoobj_color_indices
photoobj_color_indices.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  -- preserve NULL if either operand is NULL
  CASE WHEN p.u IS NULL OR p.g IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.u - p.g) END AS u_minus_g,
  CASE WHEN p.g IS NULL OR p.r IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.g - p.r) END AS g_minus_r,
  CASE WHEN p.r IS NULL OR p.i IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.r - p.i) END AS r_minus_i,
  CASE WHEN p.i IS NULL OR p.z IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.i - p.z) END AS i_minus_z
FROM photoobj_as_record p
photoobj_color_indices.description: Per-photoobj computed color indices (u-g, g-r, r-i, i-z) computed from photoobj magnitudes to support color-based selections and ranking. This view does not apply numeric literal cuts; it only computes differences and preserves NULLs when any operand is NULL.

photoobj_with_specobj_link_35.name: photoobj_with_specobj_link_35
photoobj_with_specobj_link_35.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  s.bestobjid AS bestobjid,
  s.specobjid AS specobjid,
  s.z AS spec_z,
  s.class AS spec_class
FROM
  photoobj p
LEFT JOIN
  specobj s
ON
  p.objid = s.bestobjid
photoobj_with_specobj_link_35.description: Left join linking photometric detections (photoobj) to spectroscopic objects (specobj) via objid -> specobj.bestobjid when available. Useful for queries needing both photometry and spectroscopy; preserves all photoobj rows.

neighbors_pairs.name: neighbors_pairs
neighbors_pairs.body_sql:
SELECT
  objid,
  neighborobjid,
  distance,
  type,
  neighbortype,
  mode,
  neighbormode
FROM
  neighbors
neighbors_pairs.description: One row per neighbor relation (direct neighbor edge) linking a primary object to a neighbor object with reported angular distance and relation/type metadata from the neighbors table. Exposes both object ids so it can be joined to photoobj rows for either side.

neighbor_colors.name: neighbor_colors
neighbor_colors.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.objid,
  n.neighborobjid,
  n.distance,
  p.u    AS u_neighbor,
  p.g    AS g_neighbor,
  p.r    AS r_neighbor,
  p.i    AS i_neighbor,
  p.z    AS z_neighbor,
  -- color differences computed from neighbor photometry (lifted literals none)
  (p.u - p.g) AS u_minus_g,
  (p.g - p.r) AS g_minus_r,
  (p.r - p.i) AS r_minus_i,
  (p.i - p.z) AS i_minus_z
FROM
  neighbors n
JOIN
  photoobj p
    ON p.objid = n.neighborobjid
neighbor_colors.description: A denormalized view: one row per neighbor relation enriched with the neighbor's photometry and computed color differences (u-g, g-r, r-i, i-z). Designed so filters on neighbor colors can be applied directly without recomputing joins each time.

photoobj_color_filtered.name: photoobj_color_filtered
photoobj_color_filtered.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  -- colors: lift literals (none) so simple differences
  (p.u - p.g) AS u_g,
  (p.g - p.r) AS g_r,
  (p.r - p.i) AS r_i,
  (p.i - p.z) AS i_z
FROM
  photoobj AS p
WHERE
  -- canonical photometry guard: require cmodel magnitudes not null for u,g,r (use columns present in photoobj)
  cmodelmag_u IS NOT NULL
  AND cmodelmag_g IS NOT NULL
  AND cmodelmag_r IS NOT NULL
  -- basic non-null guards on magnitudes and coordinates
  AND p.u IS NOT NULL
  AND p.g IS NOT NULL
  AND p.r IS NOT NULL
  AND p.i IS NOT NULL
  AND p.z IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  -- basic cleanliness: require clean flag non-zero (lift literal OUT: require = 1 would be literal; here require IS NOT NULL and positive)
  AND p.clean IS NOT NULL
photoobj_color_filtered.description: Photometric objects (photoobj) with canonical photometry and basic non-null guards, exposing colors for color-based filtering.

neighbors_pairs_39.name: neighbors_pairs_39
neighbors_pairs_39.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.objid AS objid,
  n.neighborobjid AS neighborobjid,
  n.distance AS distance,
  n.type AS type,
  n.mode AS mode
FROM
  neighbors n
WHERE
  n.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND n.neighborobjid IS NOT NULL
  AND n.distance IS NOT NULL
neighbors_pairs_39.description: Pairwise neighbor relations between objects with distance and neighbor identifiers; basic non-null guards.

photoobj_with_neighbor_info.name: photoobj_with_neighbor_info
photoobj_with_neighbor_info.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra   AS ra,
  p.dec  AS dec,
  p.u    AS u,
  p.g    AS g,
  p.r    AS r,
  p.i    AS i,
  p.z    AS z,
  n.neighborobjid AS neighborobjid,
  n.distance      AS distance
FROM
  photoobj AS p
JOIN
  neighbors AS n
  ON (p.objid = n.objid OR p.objid = n.neighborobjid)
photoobj_with_neighbor_info.description: Denormalized rows connecting a photometric object to its neighbor pair info; produces one row per (photoobj.objid, neighbors.neighborobjid) where the photoobj is either the primary or the neighbor in the pair, to allow selecting the photometric member of a binary.

photoobj_with_type.name: photoobj_with_type
photoobj_with_type.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra AS ra,
  p.dec AS dec,
  p.r AS r,
  p.extinction_r AS extinction_r,
  p.type AS type,
  pt.name AS type_name,
  p.clean AS clean,
  p.flags AS flags
FROM photoobj AS p
LEFT JOIN photo_type AS pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
photoobj_with_type.description: Denormalized view joining photoobj to photo_type to expose photometric objects along with their textual type name. Keeps one row per photo object and is suitable as the base cohort for counts or further filtering by type name and magnitude/extinction thresholds.

photoobj_galaxy_cohort_42.name: photoobj_galaxy_cohort_42
photoobj_galaxy_cohort_42.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.type,
  p.r,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.cmodelmag_r
FROM
  photoobj_as_record p
JOIN
  photo_type_lookup t
    ON p.type = t.value
WHERE
  t.name = 'GALAXY'
photoobj_galaxy_cohort_42.description: Cohort view: subset of photoobj rows that are galaxies (photo_type.name = 'GALAXY'). Keeps photometry and extinction for downstream numeric filtering; does not apply magnitude or extinction thresholds so it is reusable.

photoobj_base_43.name: photoobj_base_43
photoobj_base_43.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.b,
  p.l,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj p
photoobj_base_43.description: Canonical cleaned photometric object rows exposing positional, photometric, type and basic quality columns with nulls preserved for downstream filtering.

photoobj_with_type_44.name: photoobj_with_type_44
photoobj_with_type_44.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.g    AS g,
  p.u    AS u,
  p.r    AS r,
  p.i    AS i,
  p.z    AS z,
  p.type AS type,
  pt.name AS name
FROM photoobj AS p
LEFT JOIN photo_type AS pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
photoobj_with_type_44.description: Denormalized photometric objects joined to their type name for easy filtering by type label (keeps one row per photoobj.objid).

photoobj_photometric_measurements.name: photoobj_photometric_measurements
photoobj_photometric_measurements.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.b,
  p.l,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd,
  p.loadversion,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj AS p
photoobj_photometric_measurements.description: Canonical per-photoobject photometric measurements and basic metadata (one row per photo detection). Includes magnitudes, positions, extinction and basic flags/processing columns. Intended as a normalized projection to be filtered or joined for photometric selection.

photoobj_with_type_name_46.name: photoobj_with_type_name_46
photoobj_with_type_name_46.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.type,
  pt.name,
  pt.description,
  p.clean,
  p.flags,
  p.rowc,
  p.colc,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.b,
  p.l,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd,
  p.loadversion,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z
FROM photoobj p
LEFT JOIN photo_type pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
photoobj_with_type_name_46.description: Denormalized photoobj rows annotated with the photo_type.name and description. One row per photoobj; useful for selecting by semantic type (e.g., GALAXY) without repeating joins.

photoobj_spatial_presence.name: photoobj_spatial_presence
photoobj_spatial_presence.body_sql:
SELECT
  objid,
  ra,
  dec
FROM photoobj
WHERE objid IS NOT NULL
  AND ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
photoobj_spatial_presence.description: Cohort of photoobj rows that have non-null sky coordinates (ra, dec) and basic identifiers; useful for spatial joins, neighbor queries, and filtering out malformed rows.

neighbors_pair_distances.name: neighbors_pair_distances
neighbors_pair_distances.body_sql:
SELECT
  n.objid,
  n.neighborobjid,
  n.distance,
  n.type,
  n.mode,
  n.neighbortype,
  n.neighbormode
FROM neighbors n
neighbors_pair_distances.description: Pairwise neighbor relations from neighbors table exposing object pairs and separation; useful for spatial-neighbor filters, nearest-neighbor selection, and deduplication.

photoobj_photometry_colors.name: photoobj_photometry_colors
photoobj_photometry_colors.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  -- compute cmodelmag_i as canonical i magnitude; not present in photoobj tables, lift NULL literal out of view if desired by queries
  NULL::real AS cmodelmag_i,
  -- color differences, computed when both inputs are non-null
  CASE WHEN p.u IS NOT NULL AND p.g IS NOT NULL THEN (p.u - p.g) ELSE NULL END AS u_minus_g,
  CASE WHEN p.g IS NOT NULL AND p.r IS NOT NULL THEN (p.g - p.r) ELSE NULL END AS g_minus_r,
  CASE WHEN p.i IS NOT NULL AND p.z IS NOT NULL THEN (p.i - p.z) ELSE NULL END AS i_minus_z,
  -- validity flag: true if u,g,r,i,z and cmodelmag_u/g/r are all non-null (per requirement: "has_ugri_z_nonnull" indicate non-NULLness of the inputs;
  -- interpret as non-nullness of u,g,r,i,z and the three cmodelmags)
  (p.u IS NOT NULL AND p.g IS NOT NULL AND p.r IS NOT NULL AND p.i IS NOT NULL AND p.z IS NOT NULL
   AND p.cmodelmag_u IS NOT NULL AND p.cmodelmag_g IS NOT NULL AND p.cmodelmag_r IS NOT NULL) AS has_ugri_z_nonnull
FROM photoobj AS p
photoobj_photometry_colors.description: Precomputed color columns and simple photometric validity flags for each photoobj row to simplify selection by color/magnitude cuts (colors are computed as differences of canonical magnitudes; validity flags indicate non-NULLness of the inputs).

photoobj_spatial_index_basic.name: photoobj_spatial_index_basic
photoobj_spatial_index_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- integerized RA/DEC tile indices (coarse grid). Lifted literals: tile_size_deg = 1.0
  floor(ra / 1.0)::integer AS tile_ra,
  floor(dec / 1.0)::integer AS tile_dec,

  -- count of photoobj rows per tile
  count(*) AS obj_count,

  -- representative/min/max coordinates per tile to allow bounding and joins back to rows
  min(ra) AS min_ra,
  max(ra) AS max_ra,
  min(dec) AS min_dec,
  max(dec) AS max_dec
FROM
  photoobj
-- consider only rows with valid coordinates
WHERE
  ra IS NOT NULL
  AND dec IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  floor(ra / 1.0)::integer,
  floor(dec / 1.0)::integer
photoobj_spatial_index_basic.description: Spatial bucketing of photoobj rows by coarse sky tile (simple integerized RA/DEC bins) to enable spatial filtering/aggregation and fast neighborhood counts. Produces counts per tile and exposes representative min/max RA/DEC to join back to row-level data if needed.

photoobj_sky_and_colors.name: photoobj_sky_and_colors
photoobj_sky_and_colors.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  -- derived simple colors from raw magnitudes; lift any literals out (none needed here)
  (p.u - p.g) AS u_minus_g,
  (p.g - p.r) AS g_minus_r,
  p.g
FROM photoobj AS p
photoobj_sky_and_colors.description: Per-photoobj row exposing sky coordinates and derived simple colors (u-g, g-r) computed from raw magnitudes for convenient color-based selection.

specobj_spectroscopic_class_and_redshift.name: specobj_spectroscopic_class_and_redshift
specobj_spectroscopic_class_and_redshift.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.class,
  s.z,
  s.zerr,
  s.mjd,
  s.plate,
  s.fiberid
FROM specobj AS s
specobj_spectroscopic_class_and_redshift.description: Per-spectrum spectroscopic classification and redshift information from specobj, mapped to its best matched photo object id. Use this to join spectroscopy-derived class/redshift to photo detections.

photoobj_with_spec_match.name: photoobj_with_spec_match
photoobj_with_spec_match.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
  p.objid::bigint AS objid,
  p.ra::double precision AS ra,
  p.dec::double precision AS dec,
  p.g::real AS g,
  s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid,
  s.class::character varying AS class,
  s.z::real AS z
FROM
  specobj s
JOIN
  photoobj p
ON
  s.bestobjid = p.objid
photoobj_with_spec_match.description: Denormalized relation joining photoobj to specobj via specobj.bestobjid = photoobj.objid, producing one row per photoobj that has associated spectroscopy (one specobj row per match). Exposes photometry, position, spectroscopic class and redshift for cohort filtering and selection.

specobj_core_54.name: specobj_core_54
specobj_core_54.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.ra,
  s.dec,
  s.z,
  s.zerr,
  s.zwarning,
  s.class,
  s.subclass,
  s.mjd,
  s.plate,
  s.fiberid,
  s.survey,
  s.programname
FROM specobj s
specobj_core_54.description: Canonical per-spectroscopic-object projection with redshift, classification, and linking to photometric object via bestobjid.

photoobj_with_spec_link.name: photoobj_with_spec_link
photoobj_with_spec_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid                AS "photoobj.objid",
  p.ra                   AS "photoobj.ra",
  p.dec                  AS "photoobj.dec",
  p.g                    AS "photoobj.g",
  s.specobjid            AS "specobj.specobjid",
  s.bestobjid            AS "specobj.bestobjid",
  s.z                    AS "specobj.z",
  s.class                AS "specobj.class"
FROM
  photoobj p
LEFT JOIN
  specobj s
ON
  s.bestobjid = p.objid
photoobj_with_spec_link.description: Denormalized row-level view joining photometric objects to their linked spectroscopic object (if any) via specobj.bestobjid -> photoobj.objid, exposing both photometry and spectroscopy columns for easy cohort filtering.
